chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
4/4 with a light bouncy swing, a continuous friendly groove that keeps moving
cheerful marimba lead melody, a touch comic
pizzicato strings bouncing on the offbeats
music box and a bright doorbell ding-ding figure as the hook
bouncy plucked sampled bass hopping root and fifth
soft brushes and a little tambourine
small cosy village shop interior, close and intimate, short warm room reverb
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat
seamless transition back to the theme
